description: This file defines an ApprovalService class for managing submission approvals, including e-signature verification, approval/rejection workflows, and related error handling. It interacts with a database, audit, and evidence services, and includes methods for e-signature verification and approval processing.

classes.name: ApprovalError
classes.description: Base exception class for approval-related errors.

classes.name: SoDViolationError
classes.description: Exception for Segregation of Duties violations.

classes.name: SignatureError
classes.description: Exception for electronic signature validation failures.

classes.name: InvalidStateError
classes.description: Exception for invalid workflow state transitions.

classes.name: ApprovalService
classes.description: Service class managing approval workflows, e-signature validation, and related processes.

methods.name: verify_esign
methods.description: Verifies electronic signature credentials and creates a signed record.

methods.name: approve_submission
methods.description: Handles approval or rejection of submissions with validation, signature checks, and state updates.
